transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. I'm here because I've been having a really hard time listening when people are talking directly to me. It feels like my mind just drifts off, even when I'm trying my best to pay attention.
Beyond the difficulty focusing, do you often find yourself feeling restless, fidgety, or struggling to remain seated when you are expected to?

Yes, I definitely experience that. I often feel a constant sense of inner restlessness and find it really hard to just sit still. Even when I'm expected to remain seated, I have this strong urge to fidget, tap my feet, or constantly shift around.

latest_inference.note: The patient reports both significant inattentive symptoms (difficulty listening/mind drifting) and hyperactive/impulsive symptoms (restlessness, fidgeting, inability to remain seated). Since both criteria sets are present, the Combined Presentation is the most accurate diagnosis among the candidates.
